programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment

programme.title: The Lightbulb Moment

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

As the village's dark history is revealed, it becomes clear that the evil stems from the immortal Vargas Diaz (Danny Trejo), who must be stopped at any cost.

programme.title: Dead Birds
programme.desc: William (Henry Thomas), a Confederate soldier, has gone AWOL with a crew of other men. As the group, among it a runaway slave (Isaiah Washington) and a nurse (Nicki Aycox), makes its way along, it stops off to rob a bank clean. Looking to plan a getaway, the gang heads into an empty house to hole up for the evening. As the soldiers start arguing with one another, strange things begin happening in the house -- and everyone in the group soon realizes that the place is haunted.

programme.title: Return of the Lash
programme.desc: Cheyenne Davis (Lash La Rue) comes to the rescue of a group of ranchers who are losing their homes to a gang of malicious outlaws. When Davis and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), capture the outlaws, they collect reward money to distribute to the ranchers. But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

programme.title: Black Tuesday
programme.desc: Vincent Canelli (Edward G. Robinson) and his comrade in crime, Peter Manning (Peter Graves), bust out of prison on the day Canelli is supposed to be executed for murder. The convicts take prisoners with them, including a priest (Milburn Stone), and hide out in an abandoned warehouse. The plan is for Canelli to grab the loot that got them in the slammer to begin with. But their plan is complicated when the police surround them, and Canelli threatens to start killing hostages one by one.

programme.title: Incident in an Alley
programme.desc: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

programme.title: Storm Fear
programme.desc: A wounded bank robber (Cornel Wilde) hides with his gang at his brother (Dan Duryea) and sister-in-law's (Jean Wallace) farm in a snowstorm.

programme.title: Killers Three
programme.desc: A World War II veteran (Robert Walker), his wife (Diane Varsi) and a war buddy (Dick Clark) botch a robbery in North Carolina.

programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. He enjoys a quiet existence with his Malayan girlfriend, Dhana (Capucine), although a politician's daughter named Candace (Susannah York) also fancies him. Soon, Ferris encounters a man named Ng (Tetsuro Tamba), who served with him during the war and is now a communist committed to revolution for the guerillas. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her.

programme.title: War Hunt
programme.desc: Toward the end of the Korean War, young Pvt. Roy Loomis (Robert Redford) joins the soldiers at the front line. In Loomis' new infantry company, he encounters Pvt. Raymond Endore (John Saxon), a man with an intense desire to kill. Endore undertakes lone nightly reconnaissance missions, where he's made a habit of cutting suspected enemies' throats. The company's leader (Charles Aidman) does little to stop this behavior -- and when the armistice is announced, Endore has no intention of leaving.

programme.title: Secret of Deep Harbor
programme.desc: A reporter (Ron Foster) covers the waterfront and catches his girlfriend's (Merry Anders) father (Barry Kelley) smuggling gangsters.

programme.title: The Naked Street
programme.desc: Rosalie (Anne Bancroft) is the sister of notorious, well-connected mobster Phil (Anthony Quinn). When Rosalie ends up pregnant by Nicky (Farley Granger), an upstart crook facing a death sentence, Phil uses his influence to clear the soon-to-be-father's name and get him out of prison so that he can marry Rosalie. When the young woman loses her baby because of a medical complication, Nicky promptly ditches her. But Phil doesn't take kindly to this, and decides to make Nicky's life a living hell.

programme.title: Johnny Cool
programme.desc: A rich divorcee (Jim Backus) joins a Sicilian hit man (Henry Silva) sent to Los Angeles by a deported mobster.

programme.title: A Bullet for Joey
programme.desc: Recruited for a kidnapping, a deported gangster (George Raft) ends up busting a Communist spy ring for a Mountie (Edward G. Robinson).

programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: The Lone Runner
programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Miles O'Keeffe) on horseback rescues a European damsel (Savina Gersak), using only a crossbow and explosive arrows.

programme.title: Deadly Impact
programme.desc: After a brilliant killer once again resurfaces, a cop (Sean Patrick Flanery) joins forces with the FBI to bring the psychopath to justice.

programme.title: Marshal Law
programme.desc: In the wake of a devastating earthquake, a former U.S. marshal (Jimmy Smits) fights thugs terrorizing an isolated Los Angeles community.

programme.title: Killing Streets
programme.desc: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. Nevertheless, Craig has the uncanny feeling that his brother is still alive -- and that he's the only one who can save him.

programme.title: The One That Got Away
programme.desc: Franz von Werra (Hardy Kruger) is a Luftwaffe pilot by trade, but an escape artist by necessity. When his plane is attacked over England, he initiates his first effort to break out of the POW camp only days after arriving. Transferred to a second, more secure facility, Franz nevertheless manages to tunnel out and very nearly steals an airplane before being recaptured. This time the Allies send him to be imprisoned in Canada, but he steadfastly insists that no cell will hold him.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: The Comedy of Terrors
programme.desc: Waldo Trumbull (Vincent Price) is an amoral undertaker in 19th-century New England who takes to murdering people to have enough cash to support his drinking habit. Desperate for money after a widow stiffs him for a burial, Trumbull and his assistant, Gillie (Peter Lorre), decide to kill the wealthy Mr. Black (Basil Rathbone), their landlord, to whom they're indebted. But murdering Black proves to be quite a challenge, as he seems to keep recovering from death every time they do him in.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 2: Unhappy Campers
programme.desc: Angela Baker (Pamela Springsteen), a psychotic transsexual, escapes from a mental hospital and surfaces at a summer camp as a counselor who lectures her teenage charges on proper moral behavior. Those teens who break her strict rules -- from the camp chatterbox or a sex-obsessed girl to the boys who are peeping Toms -- are murdered by the impostor in various gruesome ways. As more campers go missing, intrepid counselor Molly (Renee Estevez) begins to piece together the truth.

programme.title: Sleepaway Camp 3: Teenage Wasteland
programme.desc: Psychotic Angela (Pamela Springsteen) is itching to do what she does best: slaughter dozens of teenage campers. As luck would have it, the previous site of her murders has been renamed and converted into an experimental summer camp meant to bring together privileged and lower-class teens. On the day the youths are boarding the buses to camp, Angela runs over a potential camper with a garbage truck and assumes her identity. Once she has infiltrated the camp, the real terror begins.

programme.title: Dr. Heckyl and Mr. Hype
programme.desc: The kind but physically disfigured Dr. Heckyl is so distraught over his continual failures with the opposite sex that he decides to end his life by overdosing on an extra-strength diet drink. Strangely, he doesn't die -- he transforms into slick stud Mr. Hype. Unfortunately, Hype has an insatiable thirst for blood, and he ends up killing his dates before any romance unfolds. He soon sets his sights on the sweet Coral, who secretly loves Heckyl, but not Hype.

programme.title: The Lost Empire
programme.desc: Long-legged women warriors dress lightly on the island of evil Dr. Sin Do, also known as Li Chuk.

programme.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
programme.desc: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang.

programme.title: X: The Man With the X-Ray Eyes
programme.desc: Intent on enhancing mankind's ocular ability, the brilliant Dr. James Xavier (Ray Milland) invents a formula that allows him to see wavelengths of light outside the normal human spectrum. When his funding is suddenly threatened, Xavier tests the formula on himself despite the protests of his colleague Dr. Diane Fairfax (Diana Van der Vlis). While the formula proves initially useful in a variety of minor tasks, Xavier soon finds himself able to see things that no man was meant to see.

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: Scott Warrington (Mauritz Hugo) returns to his childhood home in Louisiana after learning that his deceased sister, Lila (Veda Ann Borg), may have been poisoned. He brings a detective (Robert Lowery) with him, and they switch identities to protect Scott. At first, they find only Lila's sad husband, Dr. von Altermann (John Carradine). Secretly, however, von Altermann is a Nazi who has been perfecting a way to turn the dead, including Lila, into an army of zombies who will serve Hitler.

programme.title: Fanfare for a Death Scene
programme.desc: A federal agent (Richard Egan) tries to find a missing physicist who keeps a top-secret formula in his head.

programme.title: No Such Thing
programme.desc: Disgusted with human evolution, a foul-mouthed monster kills anyone who crosses his path. When a news crew sent to investigate the monster disappears, a guileless young woman is dispatched to follow up on the story. She befriends the monster and becomes his only hope in ending his life of misery.

programme.title: Tower of London
programme.desc: In 15th-century England, Richard III (Vincent Price) desperately wants the throne, but his ailing brother, King Edward IV (Justice Watson), instead bestows it upon his other sibling, Clarence (Richard McCauly). This sends Richard into a homicidal rage, resulting in Clarence's murder and the deaths and torture of many others who could keep the crown from the crazed man. But as the mayhem continues, Richard's sanity slips, and the ghosts of the murdered men begin to haunt the beleaguered royal.

programme.title: The Pit and the Pendulum
programme.desc: Elizabeth Barnard Medina (Barbara Steele) has died in the prime of life, and her brother, Francis (John Kerr), wants to know why. Elizabeth's husband, Nicholas (Vincent Price), and her doctor offer differing explanations, but when Francis learns that Nicholas' mother may have been buried alive, he begins to wonder if his sister met the same fate. And when he comes to believe that Elizabeth's spirit wanders about Nicholas' castle, Francis investigates -- and is stunned by what he finds.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: The career of horror icon Paul Toombes (Vincent Price) ends in scandal when his fiancée dies under mysterious circumstances. Freed from the mental hospital where he had been committed, the recovered Toombes and screenwriter Herbert Flay (Peter Cushing) intend to revive his most popular character, Dr. Death, for a television series. But the dead bodies start piling up -- all of them killed in ways that mimic the victims in Toombes' films -- and to clear his name he must find the real killer.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Haunted Palace
programme.desc: Condemned warlock Joseph Curwen curses a New England village just before being burned alive. More than a century later, Curwen's kindly great-great-grandson Charles Ward (also Price) arrives in town and moves into Curwen's old mansion. Caretaker Simon Orne helps Charles and his wife Ann adjust to their new home. The ancient curse, however, takes hold of Joseph, awakening inside him a long-dormant evil passed on through blood.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Shield for Murder
programme.desc: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. Unbeknownst to Nolan, however, the entire episode is witnessed by a deaf-mute from across the street. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder.

programme.title: Love Is a Ball
programme.desc: Matchmaker Etienne Pimm (Charles Boyer) makes his living by pairing European aristocrats with rich Americans, and his latest match is between Duke Gaspard Ducluzeau (Ricardo Montalban) and affluent heiress Millie Mehaffey (Hope Lange). Unfortunately, Ducluzeau, handsome and titled as he is, needs some help in acting aristocratic. Luckily, John Davis (Glenn Ford) is on hand to teach the Duke how to behave like the high-society man he is, at least until Davis and Mehaffey meet.

programme.title: What's New, Pussycat?
programme.desc: An irrepressible cad by nature, Michael James (Peter O'Toole) is determined to reform and stay faithful to his fiancée, Carole (Romy Schneider). However, Michael's attempt at fidelity is jeopardized when numerous attractive women become smitten with him, including Liz (Paula Prentiss) and Rita (Ursula Andress). Meanwhile, another of Michael's admirers, Renée (Capucine), is the object of fixation for his therapist, the wacky Dr. Fritz Fassbender (Peter Sellers).

programme.title: Lord Love a Duck
programme.desc: An unusually gifted high school senior, Alan Musgrave (Roddy McDowall), decides to direct his mental powers toward helping an innocent new student, Barbara Ann Greene (Tuesday Weld), achieve her goal of popularity. With Alan's guidance, Barbara climbs the social ladder, finds a husband and eventually gets a shot at a glamorous movie career. But when Barbara's husband begins to get in the way of her ambitions, Alan will stop at nothing to make sure she reaches the top.

programme.title: He Who Must Die
programme.desc: Three townspeople cause an uproar when they try to help refugees on a Greek island occupied by Turks.

programme.title: The Wild Party
programme.desc: Embittered ex-NFL pro Tom Kupfen (Anthony Quinn) has taken to hanging with a group of go-nowhere beatniks, including good-schoolgirl-gone-bad Honey (Kathryn Grant), hopped-up jazz musician Kicks Johnson (Nehemiah Persoff) and ticking time bomb Gage Freeposter (Jay Robinson). Together they drink, dabble in drugs and commit just enough petty thefts to support their lurid lifestyle. But when a con they try to pull on a couple of squares goes sour, the hip crooks get in way over their heads.

programme.title: Vice Squad
programme.desc: Capt. Barnaby (Edward G. Robinson), leader of the Los Angeles Vice Squad, is trying to track down the murderers of a beat cop. To do this, he pulls some strings to coerce help from Mona Ross (Paulette Goddard), the madam behind a local escort ring. Using this lead and further help from an informant, Barnaby hunts down a pair of bank robbers he suspects are the killers. However, the criminals prove to be hard to catch, so Barnaby must stay determined.

programme.title: The Set Up
programme.desc: Charlie Thorpe is a brilliant security expert and convicted burglar. After being released from prison, Charlie resolves to turn his life around and takes a straight job designing the security for a newly renovated bank. However, his old criminal life catches up with him when his former prison mate, Kliff, kidnaps his new girlfriend, Gina. Charlie is left with few options when Kliff blackmails him into breaking into the bank.

programme.title: Crime Against Joe
programme.desc: Joe, an unemployed artist living with his mother, is suspected of murdering bar singer Irene Crescent during a drinking binge. His alibi -- that he ran into a sleepwalker and helped her home -- is denied by the sleepwalker's father. A friend, waitress Slacks, who is secretly in love with him, comes to his aid with a false alibi. When it doesn't hold up, Joe and Slacks must go in search of the real killer themselves.

programme.title: Hot Cars
programme.desc: A car salesman is framed for the murder of a police officer when he refuses to sell stolen vehicles for gangsters.

programme.title: Shield for Murder

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. United by their last name and a mutual resolve to emigrate, Dorita and Juan agree to play along. But it gets complicated when the two begin falling for each other just as Juan reunites with his wife, Carmela (Anjelica Huston), whom he hasn't seen in decades.

programme.title: Dance With Me Henry
programme.desc: Children help an amusement-park owner (Lou Costello) and his buddy (Bud Abbott) get out of trouble with gangsters.

programme.title: Sinful Davey
programme.desc: Though his father received a death sentence for thievery, Davey Haggart (John Hurt) nevertheless wants to be a criminal too. He quits the military and starts carrying out small-time robberies. His pal Annie (Pamela Franklin) wants him to quit the criminal life, but she grudgingly helps him avoid law enforcement. Finally, though, Constable Richardson (Nigel Davenport) catches up with Davey, who will be hanged unless Annie and a fellow thief named MacNab (Ronald Fraser) can stop his execution.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
programme.desc: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Archie Hall (Robert Mitchum) shirks even the most menial tasks by slyly leading everyone to believe he's a high-ranking officer working undercover. Alongside his buddy, Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese.

programme.title: Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush
programme.desc: Frustrated that he still hasn't lost his virginity, teenage grocery store delivery boy Jamie McGregor (Barry Evans) appeals to Spike (Christopher Timothy), an older ladies' man, for advice. After failing to seal the deal with several local girls because of his working class mannerisms and a paralyzing case of teenage self-doubt, Jamie struggles to get the attention of Mary Gloucester (Judy Geeson), a beautiful classmate who doesn't seem to know he even exists.

programme.title: Clambake
programme.desc: A wealthy young man, Scott Heyward (Elvis Presley) wants to experience life outside his privileged upbringing. When he meets Tom Wilson (Will Hutchins), an earnest water-skiing instructor, Scott offers to trade places with him. As Tom warms up to the good life, Scott gets used to a less luxurious existence and falls for Dianne Carter (Shelley Fabares), who, ironically, is hoping to meet a rich man. Sticking to his humble guise, Scott tries to woo Dianne without the benefit of his true status.

programme.title: Return From the Ashes
programme.desc: An expert chess player, Stanislaus Pilgrim is also an unrepentant cad and schemer. Looking for a way to inherit a fortune, Stanislaus marries Dr. Michele Wolf, a rich Jewish widow. Later, however, he becomes involved with his wife's stepdaughter, Fabienne, resulting in a complicated web of seduction and deception that ends in murder. Will the duplicitous Stanislaus succeed in getting Michele's money?

programme.title: Greyfriars Bobby
programme.desc: When his owner, police officer John Gray (Thomas Lockyer), is killed in the line of duty, Bobby, a particularly faithful West Highland terrier, takes up residence in the graveyard where Gray was interred. Bobby charms everyone he meets, and the canine's continued exploits make him a legend among the local working poor. When oppressive factory owner Smithie (Sean Pertwee) plots to kill Bobby, Gray's impoverished young ward, Ewan (Oliver Golding), must protect him from a ruthless dog catcher.

programme.title: The Perez Family
programme.desc: In the midst of the Mariel boat lift -- a hurried exodus of refugees from Cuba going to America -- an immigration clerk accidentally presumes that dissident Juan Raul Perez (Alfred Molina) and Dorita Evita Perez (Marisa Tomei) are married. programme.title: Allotment Wives
programme.desc: An Army officer investigates a bigamy racket in which scheming women marry soldiers to collect their government checks.

programme.title: In the Heat of the Night: Who Was Geli Bendl?
programme.desc: Only the sheriff (Carroll O'Connor) knows the identity of an actress (Sydne Rome) returned home to Sparta, Miss.

programme.title: Jacqueline
programme.desc: A Belfast laborer (John Gregson) loses his job and drinks, but his daughter (Jacqueline Ryan) saves the day.

programme.title: I Want to Live!
programme.desc: This film tells the riveting true story of brazen bad girl Barbara Graham (Susan Hayward, in an Academy Award-winning performance), a perpetual offender who tries to go straight but is sent to death row after being implicated in a murder. When journalist Ed Montgomery (Simon Oakland), whose initial newspaper articles on Barbara's crime played up her recklessness, becomes convinced that she may be innocent, he begins a desperate campaign to save her from the gas chamber.

programme.title: An Infinite Tenderness
programme.desc: Two physically impaired children form a close connection to each other.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision.

programme.title: The World of Henry Orient
programme.desc: While trying to seduce a married woman (Paula Prentiss), egotistical concert pianist Henry Orient (Peter Sellers) is interrupted by two precocious schoolgirls, Valerie (Tippy Walker) and Marian (Merrie Spaeth). At first, he thinks nothing of it, but as he sees them more often, he becomes convinced they're spies for his lover's husband. The girls, meanwhile, have found out who he is, and Valerie insists she's in love. She starts a scrapbook, which her mother finds and, of course, misconstrues.

programme.title: Taras Bulba
programme.desc: The tale of a Cossack chief who has sworn to be the eternal enemy of the treacherous Poles. So, when his son falls for a beautiful Pole who has saved his life, the father is faced with the dilemma of whether to kill his own flesh and blood as a traitor. This film reinforced the Brynner stereotype as king of the Asiatic wide open spaces.

programme.title: Die, Monster, Die!
programme.desc: Scientist Stephen Reinhart travels to a small town where he plans to visit his fiancée Susan Witley and meet her parents. Oddly, when he arrives, the townspeople are unfriendly. At Susan's parents' estate, her father, Nahum, is acting suspiciously and her mother, Letitia, is hidden away in a bedroom. When Stephen and Susan begin investigating the strange behavior in town, they realize that a radioactive meteor is to blame.

programme.title: The Oblong Box
programme.desc: Julian (Vincent Price) hides his horrendously disfigured brother, Sir Edward Markham (Alister Williamson), in a tower where he is kept in chains. Anxious for freedom, Edward fakes his death with the aid of an immoral attorney, Trench (Peter Arne), and a pill that puts him into a catatonic state. But the escape plan takes a treacherous turn when Julian unwittingly buries his brother alive -- and he's later unearthed by grave robbers under the employ of malevolent Dr. Neuhardt (Christopher Lee).

programme.title: Romance and Cigarettes

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Richard "Cochise" Morris (Lawrence-Hilton Jacobs), a local basketball hero, and Leroy "Preach" Jackson (Glynn Turman), who dreams of a career in writing, are likable Chicago high school students in Chicago in the 1960s. They're into hanging out with friends, pretty girls and the Motown sounds so popular during the era. Each wants to make it big in his own way, but not everybody they meet is looking out for them, as they learn when a seemingly harmless outing goes awry.

programme.title: Hurricane Streets
programme.desc: A stark portrait of kids living on the edge, "Hurricane Streets" focuses on one teenager's fight to change the circumstances of his life. programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Soda Cracker
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Pressure Point
programme.desc: Frustrated by his inability to help an African-American patient who hates whites, a psychiatrist (Peter Falk) asks his superior (Sidney Poitier) to release him from the case. The superior relates a case from his own past during World War II when he treated a young Nazi (Bobby Darin) who despised blacks. Explaining the tragic results of the case, the older psychiatrist encourages his younger colleague not to be swayed by the patient's attitude, to remain objective and to stick with his treatment.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

programme.title: Blacula
programme.desc: During a visit to Transylvania, an African prince (William Marshall) gets turned into a vampire by Count Dracula (Charles Macaulay). Sealed in a coffin for several lifetimes, "Blacula" reawakens in the 1970s Los Angeles. Leaving a trail of bloodless victims in his wake, he pursues Lina (Vonetta McGee), a woman who bears a striking resemblance to his dead wife. Meanwhile, Dr. Gordon Thomas (Thalmus Rasulala) and top cop Lt. Peters (Gordon Pinsent) are hot on the bloodsucker's trail.

programme.title: Scream Blacula Scream
programme.desc: When a hated rival, Lisa Fortier (Pam Grier), is chosen to lead the voodoo cult of Willis Daniels' (Richard Lawson) late mother, a vengeful Willis brings the doomed vampire Prince Mamuwalde (William Marshall) back to life. Willis soon finds the vampire too powerful to control, and Lisa agrees to perform a spell that will break the curse placed on the prince. But, when racist sheriff Dunlop (Michael Conrad) gets involved, the vampire unleashes his deadly revenge.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Sugar Hill
programme.desc: When nightclub owner Langston (Larry D. Johnson) refuses to sell out to local mob boss Morgan (Robert Quarry), he is beaten to death by a gang of hired thugs. His grief-stricken fiancée, Diana "Sugar" Hill (Marki Bey), vows revenge for his murder and turns to aged voodoo authority Mama Maitresse (Zara Cully). Together they conjure up the demonic spirit of Baron Samedi (Don Pedro Colley), who agrees to help Sugar. He raises an army of zombies and sets them upon Langston's killers.

programme.title: The First Power
programme.desc: A Los Angeles policeman (Lou Diamond Phillips) hunts a killer (Jeff Kober) brought back from the gas chamber by Satan.

programme.title: Buffalo Bill and the Indians

Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.desc: After the Civil War, rancher Thomas Dunson (James Arness) leads a dangerous cattle drive across Texas with a team that includes his adopted son, Matthew (Bruce Boxleitner), and black cowboy Jack Byrd (Stan Shaw), whose presence annoys some of the white cowboys. Fearful of Indians and struggling through the dry terrain, Dunson's men grow increasingly unhappy with his authoritarian ways. Fed up, rebellious Matthew goes to work for another ranch, infuriating his father.

programme.title: Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: In this 19th-century drama, an American family from the Northeast heads to Wyoming in search of a better life, only to face tragedy and hardship. Maggie Sergent (Joanna Pettet), the hard-driving matriarch of the clan, is totally unprepared when her husband, John (William Shatner), is murdered. Left to handle the farm on her own, Maggie must choose whether to stay in Wyoming and run the farm with her children, or head back to the East Coast and the life she knows.

programme.title: From Noon Till Three
programme.desc: Bank robber Graham Dorsey spends a few hours with beautiful widow Amanda Starbuck, in which time his gang takes part in a disastrous holdup. Learning of his comrades' demise, Dorsey goes on the lam. Believing her short-term lover was killed by the law, Amanda decides to make the most of having had a liaison with the supposedly deceased desperado by writing a book about him. Much to his confusion, the still-living Dorsey watches as his name becomes legendary.

programme.title: It's a Mann's World
programme.desc: Multitalented entertainers David and Tamela Mann are known mostly for their stage and screen collaborations with producer Tyler Perry ("Meet the Browns"). "It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years.

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

programme.title: Sábados felices
programme.desc: El legendario programa televisivo más reconocido, aclamado y querido por los colombianos, que ya hace parte de la cultura del país y que ha divertido y entretenido a varias generaciones, presenta en sus segmentos característicos, una gama variada de estilos de comedia, cuenta chistes, parodias originales, caracterizaciones de importantes personalidades del país y personalidades internacionales, cuenteros y troveros. Esta serie creada por su anfitrión Alfonso Lizarazo, le ha dado la oportunidad a talentos desconocidos de llegar al estrellato, este espacio ha sido una plataforma para los que han sido aclamados como los mejores comediantes del país. El programa además apoya obras sociales y ha ayudado a recaudar recursos monetarios que han contribuido a construir muchos centros estudiantiles.

programme.title: Live: Sábados felices
programme.desc: El legendario programa televisivo más reconocido, aclamado y querido por los colombianos, que ya hace parte de la cultura del país y que ha divertido y entretenido a varias generaciones, presenta en sus segmentos característicos, una gama variada de estilos de comedia, cuenta chistes, parodias originales, caracterizaciones de importantes personalidades del país y personalidades internacionales, cuenteros y troveros. Esta serie creada por su anfitrión Alfonso Lizarazo, le ha dado la oportunidad a talentos desconocidos de llegar al estrellato, este espacio ha sido una plataforma para los que han sido aclamados como los mejores comediantes del país. El programa además apoya obras sociales y ha ayudado a recaudar recursos monetarios que han contribuido a construir muchos centros estudiantiles.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: La ruleta de la suerte
programme.desc: Una de las versiones españolas del programa de concurso clásico norteamericano de gran acogida que se inició en los años setenta, titulado "Wheel of Fortune" o la "Ruleta de la fortuna" en español. Este formato se ha realizado en más de 25 países y se ha extendido al público internacional. Los concursantes deben adivinar oraciones sobre temas variados, llenando los vacíos con letras adivinadas que ellos enuncian, el que adivine una letra perteneciente a la frase gana un premio monetario y el premio se incrementa si adivina la frase completa. Se realizan varias rondas, en la que se incrementa la dificultad y la complejidad de los temas que se abordan.

programme.title: Tu planeta: América desde el aire
programme.desc: Oklahoma, tierra de búfalos y oro negro. Del Sendero de Lagrimas al Dust Bowl, se puede volar sobre la cuna de culturas nativas y famosos como Brad Pitt y Gerónimo. Un viaje por la historia de quienes persiguieron el sueño americano.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: नयी पड़ोसन
programme.sub-title: Three men try different methods to woo their neighbour. However, her father wants her to get married to someone from his community

credits.actor: Mahek Chahal (Pooja Iyengar),Anuj Sawhney (Raju),Vikas Kalantri (Ram),Aslam Khan (Raja),Rahul Bhat (Prabhu / Gangster),Vijay Kashyap (Keshav Iyengar),Yusuf Hussain (Mr. Venkatesh Iyengar),Shabnam Kapoor (Gayatri Iyengar)

programme.title: बलविंदर सिंह... फेमस हो गया
programme.sub-title: Two struggling actors from Punjab who have the same name, Balwinder Singh, come to Mumbai and fall in love with the same woman
programme.desc: पंजाब के दो संघर्षशील अभिनेता, जिनका नाम एक ही है, बलविंदर सिंह, मुंबई आते हैं और एक ही महिला से प्यार करने लगते हैं।.

credits.actor: Mika Singh,Gabriela Bertante,Anupam Kher,Vindu Dara Singh,Rajpal Yadav,Govardhan Asrani,Mikhill Chandiramani,Rajshekhar Kapoor

programme.title: ग्लोबल बाबा
programme.sub-title: Pehlwaan, a criminal, narrowly escapes a police encounter and uses a holy man's guise to hide. Though he soon amasses many followers, he continues to carry out his illegal activities
programme.desc: पुलिस से जान बचाकर भागने के बाद पहलवान नाम का एक अपराधी एक बाबा होने का ढोंग करता है। जल्द ही वह इसकी आड़ में वह कई भक्त जुटाता है और अवैध गतिविधियाँ भी चलाता है।.

credits.actor: Abhimanyu Singh,Pankaj Tripathi,Ravi Kishan,Sandeepa Dhar,Akhilendra Mishra,Sanjay Mishra,Vishwa Bhanu,Seema Azmi

programme.title: संगदिल सनम
programme.sub-title: Falsely accused of robbery and sent to prison for 12 years, a bank manager realises upon his return that a person whom he trusted had betrayed him
programme.desc: एक बैंक प्रबंधक, कैलाश नाथ को अपने बेटे के ससुर, शंकर द्वारा डकैती के लिए फँसा कर जेल भेज दिया जाता है। वर्षों बाद, वह रिहा होता है और शंकर का आमना - सामना करने का फैसला करता है।.

credits.actor: Salman Khan,Manisha Koirala,Alok Nath,Reema Lagoo,Kiran Kumar,Raza Murad,Ashok Saraf,Shiva Rindani

programme.title: घराना
programme.sub-title: Prem Mehra loses everything after one of his employees joins hands with his rapacious rival and the two plot against him. Later, his sons work together to retrieve their family's lost wealth
programme.desc: प्रेम मेहरा अपनी सारी संपत्ति खो देता है जब उसका प्रतिद्वंद्वी धर्मदास, प्रेम के कर्मचारी के साथ मिलकर उसके हीरे चुराता है। अब परिवार को हुए इस नुकसान की भरपाई प्रेम के बेटों को ही करनी होगी।.

programme.title: 毒龍潭 / Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: 樊瑛受歹徒唐大川欺騙，盜去師父的玉龍劍，並生下一子一女；後樊遭師罰禁毒龍潭，唐抱子虞江逃走，女青兒則歸師公門下；二十年後，劍再次被盜，青女扮男裝，私下尋劍，卻遇樊舊友天涯客...

programme.title: 故都春夢 / Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: 故事源自膾炙人口的《啼笑因緣》，內容描述民國初年，富家子范嘉恕戀上歌女岑逢仙，同時又唯賣藝少女官繡珠及貌似岑的財政廳長女兒賀莉霞所迷戀。張大帥垂涎岑，更姦污了她。嘉恕後得繡珠相助，才從大帥手中救回愛人。.

programme.title: 香江花月夜 / Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: 本歌舞片由聲色藝各有千秋的何莉莉、鄭佩佩及秦萍合演三姊妹，再配以三大小生淩雲、陳厚及嶽華大鬥演技。由日本名演導井上梅次執導.

programme.title: 武松 / Tiger Killer
programme.desc: 一次醉酒後，武松赤手空拳打死一隻猛虎，因此被任命為都頭。武松兄長武大郎的妻子潘金蓮色誘武松，但遭他拒絕。後來，潘金蓮和富戶西門慶有染，及後姦情敗露，兩人繼而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉後，先殺潘金蓮再殺西門慶，為兄長報仇。.

programme.title: 卒仔抽車 / Rolls, Rolls, I Love You
programme.desc: 阿旦、墨魚、阿喜、荷官等一群窮小子，遇上生活寂寥的富豪崔東成，達成了一個賭局，要於十日內偷得崔的名車。五人與崔鬥智鬥力，終戰勝億萬富豪！.

programme.title: 西廂記 / West Chamber
programme.desc: 張生、崔鶯鶯才子佳人相會，俏紅娘從中牽赤繩；西廂夜訪，私定終身；崔老夫人知情大怒，憤而拷紅；紅娘怨夫人不該言而無信，終成就百年姻緣。.

programme.title: 神鵰俠侶 / Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: 郭靖與黃蓉將結拜兄弟楊康之子撫養成人，並取名楊過。黃蓉恐其學武後，替父報仇，為免養虎為患，不許楊過習武。負氣出走的楊過偶遇走火入魔的歐陽鋒，獲授蛤蟆功，更無意中獲悉自己的身世…….

programme.title: 夕陽戀人 / Sunset
programme.desc: 這是日本導演上梅次文藝片的經典。故事描述井莉飾的車衣女工與秦沛飾的修車工，在夕陽萌生感情，後女因識破男的太子爺身份，深感受騙...

programme.title: 叉手 / Masked Avengers
programme.desc: 「叉手」為江湖上新崛起之組織，專殺江湖豪俠，彼等行事，均帶面具，故彼等究為何人，無人知曉。「八臂哪吒」齊山雲會同曾軍及梁勇等，赴景陽鎮調查叉手總壇之所在，擬一舉殲滅該組織，為江湖除害。三人在客棧見一沉默寡言之伙頭，態度極為神秘，暗忖此人必也是來偵查「叉手」者...

programme.title: 玉堂春 / The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: 王金龍與名妓蘇三相愛，無奈無錢被趕出富春院。蘇被老鴇賣予富戶沈燕林為妾，卻被沈妻誣告毒殺親夫，判以死罪。已考取功名的王，決意開堂覆審救蘇...

programme.title: 武館 / Martial Club
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與天壽武館之王隱林年少氣盛，得罪陸正甫武館少主及其騁用的高手單雄，從而掀起武館間的正面衝突。本片是劉家良導演最得意的作品，更是1981年十大賣座電影之一。.

programme.title: 雙鐲 / The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: 兩名少女作盟誓要在一個沒有女權，甚或缺乏性自由的小漁村互相照顧一生。一位最終下嫁自己不認識的人，之後過著幸福快樂的日子。而另一位少女則慘遭許配給虐待成性的富家子，於是她唯有設法擺脫這個困境。.

programme.title: 血鸚鵡 / Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡，看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相；與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜，葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡，鐵死於它的魔力之下；後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後，屍體卻離奇失蹤，葉經歷重重險阻後，終於見到真正的血鸚鵡….

programme.title: 血鸚鵡 / Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: 據說諸魔化成的血鸚鵡，看見它的人能得到三個願望。江湖俠盜葉停楓為追尋血鸚鵡的真相；與名捕「鐵手無情」鐵恨聯手。某夜，葉、鐵二人在墳場遇上血鸚鵡，鐵死於它的魔力之下；後葉將其屍體送回家鄉安葬。其後，屍體卻離奇失蹤，葉經歷重重險阻後，終於見到真正的血鸚鵡….

programme.title: 狂戀詩 / Summer Heat
programme.desc: 大偉和小春是同胞兄弟，一個放浪，一個含蓄。小春在舞會邂逅女子珠迪，情心一片。大偉發現珠迪有個年老丈夫，得知此秘密，大偉以此威脅，迫珠迪和他幽會，自始珠迪周旋三個男人之間... 導演以女性角度大膽描寫男女情關，手法細膩，而結局亦出人意表。.

programme.title: 清宮啟示錄 / The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: 清朝兩位太子為要爭奪帝位，令人民死傷無數。被牽連在這場皇室鬥爭當中的女刺客，最終能否及時執行刺殺任務以助其中一位皇子登上皇位？.

programme.title: 銷魂玉 / Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: 王致和無意得到通靈玩意，許下三個願望，雖然願望靈驗之極，結果落得家散人亡；風塵女孟薇被情人林坤全害死，變成水鬼復仇；豔麗女子蕭雲玉香消玉殞後，仍不斷在人間走動，盜墳贼欲挖開蕭雲玉墳墓盜取陪葬珠寶，終被蕭雲玉追殺致死...

programme.title: 踩綫 / Murderer Pursues
programme.desc: 本片由著名演員王鍾編導，為 1981年的社會寫實電影。故事描述，呂良偉與李修賢在片中均為中越混血兒， 由越南逃至澳門；呂於香港出生，可在港居留，乃與李分散；鄭則仕飾呂之叔父，為一幹練警探，即介紹呂加入員警世界，派其作臥底。後鄭一次與越南匪徒糾鬥中 遭殺害；而李則被牽涉入這宗凶案...

programme.title: 千門八將 / Notorious Eight
programme.desc: 盡窺賭術內幕的影片《千門八將》講述，正將是道上叱吒風雲的“賭王”。一次，他在與“賭魔”的賭局中，被其暗算而隱恨退出江湖。二十年後，賭魔以計迫使正將重出賭壇，正將被賭魔以千術擊敗，含怨吐血而亡。正將之子為報父仇，邀其請昔日與其父親出生入死的拍檔“千門八將”與賭魔展開連場賭博......

programme.title: 青春1000日 / The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰與方素美是一對感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃，由當舞女之姊撫養成長，方則出身富家，受母呵護備至。畢業後，凌由淪落風塵攀至選美冠軍，方則滿足於平淡生活中；但她們卻偏偏同時愛上劉醫生。最後一件意想不到的事發生，改寫了他們三人的一生….

programme.title: 殺手三分半鐘 / The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: 職業殺手雷振華在尖東某夜總會成功殺死黑道名流四哥等人後，悄然來到馬來西亞並住進唐人街對面一舊式旅館。唐人街的豪華酒店裡正舉行一個盛大婚禮，新郎石先生正是雷計畫用三分半鐘解決的目標，不料，未等雷下手，另一殺手已捷足先登，倒在地上卻是另一要人，雷頓時成了替罪羊。.

programme.title: 憤怒青年 / The Delinquent
programme.desc: 沈昌生性沉鬱，與父親缺乏溝通，被人利用，誤入歧途。昌逃不過暴力的魔爪和色情的引誘，竟然出賣父親，讓父親慘死。昌悲悔交加，獨闖飛仔巢，逐一將之擊斃，自已也進入瘋狂狀態。.

programme.title: 玉面俠 / The Jade Faced Assassin
programme.desc: 章臻與月奴相愛卻不被接納，二人被四怪所殺後，留下一對雙胞兒。月奴的姊姊希望挽救其門派的聲望，拆散雙胞，將他們分別送到對立門派收養。十八年後，雙胞胎兒重聚，互相傷殘，亦隨即掀起江湖風風雨雨。.

programme.title: 乾隆皇奇遇記 / Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: 乾隆皇帝微服出巡，希望藉此了解百姓的生活需要，但卻碰上連串的奇遇，乾隆更被衙差關進牢獄，差點要被斬首…最後又有誰可拯救皇帝出困境？.

programme.title: 太陰指 / Finger of Doom
programme.desc: 故事描述，路天保與兩個結拜兄弟，巧遇奉師命清理門戶的躺棺長髮少女與四行屍人...

programme.title: 傾國傾城 / The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: 李翰祥史詩式電影，藝術成就及導演功力震驚中港台三地。本片榮獲金馬優等劇情片、最佳女主角及最佳彩色影片美術設計獎項。影后盧燕飾慈禧太后；處女演出即成名的蕭瑤，飾死後受追封為貴妃的珍妃；而為珍妃逝世而不近女色的光緒帝則是狄龍。.

programme.title: 大旗英雄傳 / Clan Feuds
programme.desc: 鐵中棠是大旗門掌門人雲翼的義子。門派宿敵司徒笑為奪取秘藏，追殺鐵中棠與雲翼次子雲錚。鐵中棠得知，唯有前往長春島尋找武功蓋世的「日后」，才能揭開大旗門的秘密。然而抵達後卻發現「日后」早已身亡，反而遇見大旗門創始人「夜帝」鐵毅，並驚覺對方竟是自己的親生父親。.

programme.title: 港澳傳奇 / Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆，識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後，威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻；香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人，事後恬要求與石同居，結局出人意表...

programme.title: 港澳傳奇 / Forbidden Tales of Two Cities
programme.desc: 澳門古玩店老闆，識破老婆與估衣鋪老闆有染後，威脅胡幫他引誘垂涎已久的王妻；香港賭徒在澳賭場邂逅流黑市夫人，事後恬要求與石同居，結局出人意表...

programme.title: 奪棍 / The Fighting Fool
programme.desc: 一天，絕代棍王紅鷹被惡霸擄走，徒弟阿檬誓要救出師父。途中，阿檬遇上雖貪財，卻武功了得的朱頭炳。在阿檬的利誘下，朱頭炳決定一同出發營救紅鷹。即使二人南轅北轍，但最終仍合力與惡霸終極一戰。.

programme.title: 寶蓮燈 / The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: 這是一個耳熟能詳之中國民間神話故事，講述書生劉彥昌巧遇落入凡間的聖母三娘，二人一見鍾情，結下一段仙凡姻緣。但因與二郎神結怨，屢遭迫害，二郎神更將聖母壓在華山底下。彥昌與聖母之子沉香長大後，聞悉生母被壓華山，悲憤欲絕，藉神斧之助挫敗二郎神，劈山救母。.

programme.title: 吉祥賭坊 / The Casino
programme.desc: 一對青梅竹馬的情侶相隔多年後在神秘的吉祥賭坊相遇，二人決意要一起剷除貪污的將軍、罪犯和勒索者！.

programme.title: 牛鬼蛇神 / Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: 軍閥割據時代，江湖人物及狡黠之徒所玩弄的傳統騙術層出不窮，「蛇神」、「李三腳」、「三隻手」等一群妖言惑眾的騙徒令人云亦云的愚民上釣，反映舊時代一切牛鬼蛇神眾生相。.

programme.title: 水兒武士 / Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: 水兒原是大太子之私生女，流落青樓 ，二太子欲利用水兒揭大太子醜行以謀皇位。大太子不惜派殺手暗殺水兒，而二太子則命燕十三、練飛霞等護送水兒回宮。兩批人沿途激戰，水兒得武士相救避禍隱居荒村，然二人性格迥異經常引起衝突。.

programme.title: 三笑 / The Three Smiles
programme.desc: 風流才子唐伯虎邂逅了丫鬟秋香，被她所吸引，遂決定隱瞞身份，進入華家作書僮，藉此接近秋香，並向她表明自己的身份和來意，可惜秋香並不相信。最後，唐伯虎憑藉其出眾的個人才智及好友的協助下，終於抱得美人歸。.

programme.title: 警察 / Police Force
programme.desc: 梁觀偕同情侶沈燕，在郊外遊玩談心時，不幸遇上歹徒劫財色，梁護花不成更慘遭毒手。梁之摯友黃國棟報仇心切，遂毅然投身警界，期有機會親自偵緝兇手。五年後，黃因出眾表現被升職之餘，亦與沈日久生情；不久，因一宗離奇的謀殺案件，沈認出當年殺害梁的兇手…….

programme.title: 雙鳳奇緣 / The Female Prince
programme.desc: 秦鳳笙、鳳簫兄妹才情敏捷，滿腹經綸，卻常受繼母夏氏刻薄。鳳簫自幼許與李如龍為妻，夏氏貪圖富貴，強逼如龍退婚；如龍不肯，夏氏再施毒計誣告如龍偷盜，將其收在獄中。鳳簫為救如龍，與侍婢春蘭喬扮男裝上京，更以如龍之名赴考，一舉中恩科狀元。明世宗見鳳簫長得一表非凡，乃命相國為媒，招為駙馬。洞房之夕，鳳簫向公主言明真相，並說服公主，安排一條妙計….

programme.title: 神劍震江湖 / The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: 余乾文與同門師弟鄭坤元奉師父之命下山尋訪「天地劍」，以免它落入壞人手中造成武林浩劫。余乾文途中巧遇五毒教教主之女蘇皎皎，兩人情投意合。可惜，當蘇皎皎意外地弄傷鄭坤元後，事情也開始變得越來越複雜。.

programme.title: 紅樓夢 / Dream of the Red Chamber(1961)
programme.desc: 這部電影改編自中國史上最廣受歡迎的文學作品《紅樓夢》，被譽為同名電影中最成功的作品。樂蒂生動地詮釋了美麗卻帶有一絲哀愁的林黛玉角色，也因此贏得了「古典美人」的美譽。.

programme.title: 孔雀王朝 / Murder Plot
programme.desc: 遊俠沈浪與六大門派高手商討對付奸梟歡喜王，正值莊內嚴肅之際，其未婚妻竟無理取鬧，沈只好帶其未婚妻離開。其後，二人繼續追捕歡喜王，但卻意外墮入歡喜王的圈套。.

programme.title: 拜倒石榴裙 / Forever Diamonds
programme.desc: 年輕貌美的丁芝華為緩解家中困境，與弟弟策劃了一場珠寶騙局，並打算將贓物帶往新加坡變賣。飛行途中，她為躲避海關查緝，急中生智將鑽戒塞進鄰座乘客張志賢身上，卻在出關後失去他的蹤影。無奈之下，芝華只得施展一連串笨拙又滑稽的計謀，試圖奪回戒指。.

programme.title: 幪面大俠 / That Man In Chang-an
programme.desc: 漢高祖死後,呂后專權,密詔太尉設法殺死代王劉恆。幪面大俠發現其詭計後，馬上告知劉恆。劉於是急遣護衛保護公主往長安求援。太尉率大隊軍馬沿途追殺公主,幸得幪面大俠保護,處處化險為夷。最後，幪面大俠更助劉恆成功繼承漢室大統。.

programme.title: 風花雪月 / Moods Of Love
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計，著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還，被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去，遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還；玉華無奈，只好踏上母親所走過之路...

programme.title: 風花雪月 / Moods Of Love
programme.desc: 本片由兩個單元故事組成。首個故事講述柳宣教策劃了一個破玉通禪師「色戒」之奇計，著美豔妓女紅蓮向玉通大施色誘攻勢。第二個故事講述少女馮玉華之母馮孫氏欠下九尾狐一筆錢無法償還，被逼做妓女還債。後馮孫氏因性病死去，遺下一筆債務以及殮葬費須玉華償還；玉華無奈，只好踏上母親所走過之路...

programme.title: 大刀王五 / Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: 經營鏢局的大刀王五遇上譚嗣同，這位新黨成員致力於改革清末政府。雖然皇帝支持推行新法，但慈禧太后卻無意交出政權，因此她下令捉拿新黨的所有成員。儘管王五並無政治立場，卻無奈地被捲入這場政治漩渦之中。.

programme.title: 花木蘭 / Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: 花木蘭因父親年事已高，毅然女扮男裝替父從軍，對戰匈奴。她英勇善戰，屢立奇功，更被擢升為大將軍。木蘭衣錦還鄉，為家族贏得了無上的榮光。元帥欲將女兒許配給她的時候，才得知她是女兒身。.

programme.title: 明月刀雪夜殲仇 / Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: 天下第一快刀傅紅雪為報父仇，萬里尋兇，途中七名兇手竟逐一離奇暴斃。傅紅雪與好友葉開追查真相，卻發現七人根本未死，一切皆是幕後主使「千面人魔」蕭別離操縱佈局，誘傅墮入圈套。葉開挺身相助，二人卻雙雙身陷刀陣，處境岌岌可危。.

programme.title: 星際鈍胎 / Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟，事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是，當她打算一死以示清白之際，卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意，卻遭遇一連串奇遇，而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。.

programme.title: 徐老虎與白寡婦 / The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: 本片改編自高陽同名著作，獲第18屆金馬獎最佳服裝設計、最佳美術設計兩項獎。本片講述清朝食鹽私梟徐老虎與白寡婦因清官李振彪拒不受賄，再加上責令嚴緝私鹽，二人面臨緝案危機。為免同僚落網，白獨擔罪責。徐悉白被處死，一心復仇….

programme.title: 龍虎會風雲 / Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: 故事描述，金兵侵入，身負重傷的未國將軍囑其女、羅烈及張佩山飾的的愛徒，保護太上皇玉璽，不斷出計，最終難免決一死戰...

programme.title: 七十二家房客 / The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: 七十二家房客租住一幢舊式的庭院，終日受潑辣的女房東和她卑鄙的丈夫的欺壓。一名勇於發聲的新房客出現，改變了租客的命運。他們合力對抗逼遷、抵制貪警，最終成功不讓房東出售家園。.

programme.title: 飛龍斬 / The Dragon Missile
programme.desc: 奸相秦權病重，危在旦夕，派手下爭奪長生籐。護衛司馬駿與「九指魔女」沙沙向藥師處取藥被拒，便殺死了藥師。師弟鐵二郎盜走了長生籐，司馬駿追殺鐵二郎，兩人展開了生死決鬥。.

programme.title: 女校春色 / Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: 化學教師陳子風在一間保守的女校任教，與青梅竹馬的李海倫共事。陳在醫務所拾得棄嬰，後把棄嬰帶到學校照顧，卻被學生謠傳嬰孩乃陳與李之私生子。陳不但輕鬆面對，還將朝氣帶入校園，大受學生歡迎，李亦漸漸愛上陳。但保守派對陳之作風不滿，侍機剷除陳。.

programme.title: 流氓千王 / Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: 宗華與李修賢飾賭術精湛的流氓千王，李在澳門賭場被陳萍飾的千后擊倒後，遂回港與宗合作一雪其恥，出千騙財，開設豪華賭場，欲將陳誘得入局….

programme.title: 花街時代 / My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: 少女美麗為謀生來到灣仔酒吧當吧女，自此淪落風塵。其後，美麗在酒吧認識占美，深深愛上他，並確定自己已找到真愛。當占美要離開的時候，傷心的美麗即陷入低潮，直到遇上黑幫頭目王英才有了倚靠。.

programme.title: 江湖三女俠 / Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: 故事講述，胸懷野心的朱天翔得知韓氏三姐妹若蘭、如玫、曉蓮家藏威力驚人的玄鐵神劍，若能奪得，必能戰勝「武林之尊」修德武館，稱霸江湖...

programme.title: 乾隆皇君臣鬥智 / The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: 翰林院大學士劉墉機智多謀，口才了得，常難倒乾隆。乾隆心中不忿，欲設計刁難他，但劉墉人急智生，妙語如珠，反令乾隆又再語塞。.

programme.title: Perjalanan Patah Hati
programme.desc: ada seorang gadis cantik bernama Mila yang disukai oleh beberapa orang pria tapi wanita muda tersebut menolaknya. Mila membuat patah hati para pria karena ia memilih untuk berpacaran dengan Arga, pria populer di sekolahnya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, anak-anak SMA itu reuni di sebuah villa tua. Hadir di sana beberapa orang yang terkenal saat SMA. Mereka adalah Mila Arga Dona, dan beberapa orang lainnya. Awalnya perjalanan mereka menyenangkan.Namun masalah datang Ketika Mila ditemukan meninggal secara misterius meski dinyatakan meninggal akibat kecelakaan. Orang-orang yang berada di sana, menuduh Arga menjadi dalang di balik meninggalnya Mila tersebut.

programme.title: Rasa Yang Tertinggal Di Waktu Yang Salah
programme.desc: Naura (Shanice Margaretha), perawat magang yang sering ceroboh bertemu dengan Darren (Masaji Wijayanto), seorang dokter killer yang perfeksionis. Namun, siapa sangka di balik ketegasannya, Darren memiliki sisi lembut yang mampu menarik hati Naura. Sama seperti Naura, Darren pun diam-diam merasakan perasaan yang sama terhadap Naura.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Konspirasi Rasa Penuh Tanya
programme.desc: Kiara sedang melakukan pemotretan pre wedding di sebuah butik. Tiba-tiba datang seorang pria dan ternyata pria itu kebetulan adalah mantan terindah Kiara. Bima, Bima adalah mantan terindah Kiara, SaKetika sedang membutuhkan fitting baju pengantin prianya, calon suami Kiara yang bernama Galih tidak bisa datang karena sedang sibuk syuting.Galih menyuruh Kiara untuk mencari siapa orang yang bisa menggantikannya menjadi pengantin pria. Desainer baju dan Kiara akhirnya menyuruh mantan Kiara untuk menjadi model. Sejak saat itu, Kiara dan Bima dekat hingga keduanya teringat masa lalu, tapi membuat Galih cemburu dan marah.

programme.title: Dipuji Tidak Terbang, Dicintaimu Aku Gass Bang
programme.desc: Nada sudah pacaran dengan sesama dokter, namanya Bayu, teman kuliah dulu. Saat Nada mau mengajak Bayu makan siang. Nada ke ruangan Bayu dan malah melihat bayu selingkuh dengan temannya di rumah sakit. Ingin move on dan cepat melupakan Bayu, Nada mengajukan diri untuk di pindah tugasnya. Ada anak-anak desa yang kebetulan main di sana. Nada minta tolong kepada mereka. Untuk memanggilkan kepala desanya. Harusnya kepala desa menjemput dia. Tapi mereka malah memanggil Samson. Samson sebenarnya memang diminta kepala desa, untuk menjemput dokter yang akan bertugas di puskesmas mereka.

programme.title: Hilang Untuk Kembali
programme.desc: Demi merebut kembali tanah yang diambil oleh sahabat Ayahnya, Erin nekat pergi ke Bali mencari teman Ayahnya tersebut. Sesampainya disana Erin ditabrak sebuah mobil yang ternyata adalah sahabat Ayahnya yang ia cari. Erin pun menggunakan kesempatan itu dengan sebaik-baiknya sehingga ia bisa tinggal bersama Pak Hutomo. Namun niat merebut kembali surat tanah Ayahnya tersebut, Erin justru jatuh cinta dengan anak Pak Hutomo yang bernama Bagas.

programme.title: Aku Menikah Tapi Selalu Merasa Sendiri
programme.desc: Cinta (Ina Marika) terjebak dalam pernikahan penuh luka. Bagas (El Ryan), suami Cinta mengabaikan dan mengkhianati Cinta dengan berselingkuh dengan Tiara (Angbeen Rishi). Sementara Dito (Vicky Kalea) hadir membantu Cinta dengan tulus. Saat perselingkuhan terbongkar, Cinta memilih bangkit demi diri dan anaknya.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu

programme.title: Bulatkan Tekad Uji Nyali Mengejar Cintamu
programme.desc: Irene mendapatkan sebuah hadiah liburan dengan syarat harus membawa pasangan. Sesampainya di sana, Irene kaget begitu mengetahui bahwa tempatnya horor dan juga bertemu dengan Yoga (Ridho Illahi). Namun, masalah yang dihadapi Yoga dan Irene bukan hanya diteror hantu, tapi ternyata mereka pun diteror pasangan mereka yang cemburuan.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Manipulasi Rasa Hingga Terlena
programme.desc: Suasana di area sekolah riuh pikuk ketika Aaron (Kevin Ardilova) dan geng-nya tiba. Maklum aja, Aaron adalah cowok idola karena selain ganteng, dia juga famous sebagai model dan bintang iklan. Elena (Kaneishia Yusuf), si cupu berkaca-mata dengan rambut kepang dua sedang bawa keranjang kue jualannya. Saking banyaknya Elena sampai nggak bisa lihat ke depan, padahal ada Aaron and the genks yang lagi tebar pesona ke para fans. Aaron pun nabrak Elena hingga kue-kue jualan Elena jatuh ke lantai. Elena bukannya marah malah terpesona sama kegantengan Aaron yang mirip Dewa Yunani.

programme.title: Bulatkan Tekad Uji Nyali Mengejar Cintamu
programme.desc: Irene mendapatkan sebuah hadiah liburan dengan syarat harus membawa pasangan. Sesampainya di sana, Irene kaget begitu mengetahui bahwa tempatnya horor dan juga bertemu dengan Yoga (Ridho Illahi). Namun, masalah yang dihadapi Yoga dan Irene bukan hanya diteror hantu, tapi ternyata mereka pun diteror pasangan mereka yang cemburuan.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Perjalanan Patah Hati
programme.desc: ada seorang gadis cantik bernama Mila yang disukai oleh beberapa orang pria tapi wanita muda tersebut menolaknya. Mila membuat patah hati para pria karena ia memilih untuk berpacaran dengan Arga, pria populer di sekolahnya. Beberapa tahun kemudian, anak-anak SMA itu reuni di sebuah villa tua. Hadir di sana beberapa orang yang terkenal saat SMA. Mereka adalah Mila Arga Dona, dan beberapa orang lainnya. Awalnya perjalanan mereka menyenangkan.Namun masalah datang Ketika Mila ditemukan meninggal secara misterius meski dinyatakan meninggal akibat kecelakaan. Orang-orang yang berada di sana, menuduh Arga menjadi dalang di balik meninggalnya Mila tersebut.

programme.title: Rasa Yang Tertinggal Di Waktu Yang Salah
programme.desc: Naura (Shanice Margaretha), perawat magang yang sering ceroboh bertemu dengan Darren (Masaji Wijayanto), seorang dokter killer yang perfeksionis. Namun, siapa sangka di balik ketegasannya, Darren memiliki sisi lembut yang mampu menarik hati Naura. Sama seperti Naura, Darren pun diam-diam merasakan perasaan yang sama terhadap Naura.

programme.title: Konspirasi Rasa Penuh Tanya
programme.desc: Kiara sedang melakukan pemotretan pre wedding di sebuah butik. Tiba-tiba datang seorang pria dan ternyata pria itu kebetulan adalah mantan terindah Kiara. Bima, Bima adalah mantan terindah Kiara, SaKetika sedang membutuhkan fitting baju pengantin prianya, calon suami Kiara yang bernama Galih tidak bisa datang karena sedang sibuk syuting.Galih menyuruh Kiara untuk mencari siapa orang yang bisa menggantikannya menjadi pengantin pria. Desainer baju dan Kiara akhirnya menyuruh mantan Kiara untuk menjadi model. Sejak saat itu, Kiara dan Bima dekat hingga keduanya teringat masa lalu, tapi membuat Galih cemburu dan marah.

programme.title: Dipuji Tidak Terbang, Dicintaimu Aku Gass Bang
programme.desc: Nada sudah pacaran dengan sesama dokter, namanya Bayu, teman kuliah dulu. Saat Nada mau mengajak Bayu makan siang. Nada ke ruangan Bayu dan malah melihat bayu selingkuh dengan temannya di rumah sakit. Ingin move on dan cepat melupakan Bayu, Nada mengajukan diri untuk di pindah tugasnya. Ada anak-anak desa yang kebetulan main di sana. Nada minta tolong kepada mereka. Untuk memanggilkan kepala desanya. Harusnya kepala desa menjemput dia. Tapi mereka malah memanggil Samson. Samson sebenarnya memang diminta kepala desa, untuk menjemput dokter yang akan bertugas di puskesmas mereka.

programme.title: Pelarian Yang Sempurna Hati Yang Terbagi
programme.desc: Suatu keadaan darurat yang memaksa mereka bekerja sama. Awalnya, mereka saling membenci, terbawa konflik dan dendam dari masa lalu. Namun seiring perjalanan kisah, mereka menemukan bahwa luka lama bisa disembuhkan, dan di antara pertengkaran serta kesalahpahaman, benih-benih perasaan baru mulai tumbuh.

programme.title: Diamor Cintaku Padamu Si Pencuri Motor
programme.desc: Mita kaget saat mengetahui adiknya yang mengalami kecelakaan dan harus dirawat di rumah sakit. Mita yang membutuhkan uang untuk biaya berobat adiknya terpaksa bergabung dengan komplotan pencuri motor milik Gilang. Komplotan pencuri yang menamakan dirinya Diamor itu tidak asal mencuri, mereka mencuri motor milik para orang kaya yang mendapatkan kekayaannya dari hasil korupsi.

programme.title: Buletin iNews Pagi
programme.desc: Program berita harian yang menyajikan berbagai peristiwa terkini secara cepat dan akurat dari seluruh Indonesia. programme.title: Amazing Kids : Kiko
programme.desc: Animasi Kiko mengisahkan petualangan Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang mandiri dan riang, bersama empat sahabat setianya: Lola (ikan diskus), Ting Ting (kepiting), Patino (ikan patin), dan Poli (ikan cupang). Mereka menjalani berbagai kisah seru dan memecahkan masalah di bawah laut.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Pada Zaman Dahulu
programme.desc: Pada Zaman Dahulu adalah serial animasi yang mengangkat kisah fabel rakyat Melayu, terutama kecerdikan Sang Kancil. Cerita berpusat pada Aki yang menceritakan dongeng kepada dua cucunya, Aris dan Ara, yang tinggal bersamanya di kampung. Animasi ini mengandung nilai moral, nasihat kehidupan, dan hiburan.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Zakstorm
programme.desc: Zak Storm menceritakan petualangan Zak Storm, seorang remaja yang tidak sengaja terhisap ke dalam Segitiga Bermuda saat kompetisi selancar. Di sana, ia menjadi kapten sebuah kapal bajak laut bernama Seven C, dan berteman dengan pedang ajaib bernama Calabrass, yang memungkinkannya berubah menjadi pahlawan pemberani. Bersama krunya yang unik, Zak berlayar mengarungi tujuh lautan di Segitiga Bermuda untuk mencari jalan pulang sambil menghadapi berbagai musuh kuat

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Entong
programme.desc: Animasi Entong adalah anak laki-laki Betawi berusia 10 tahun yang cerdas, saleh, dan ceria. Ia tinggal bersama ibunya, Fatimeh, di sebuah perkampungan setelah ayahnya meninggal. Kisah ini mengikuti petualangan harian Entong, persahabatannya, serta persaingannya dengan anak-anak lain seperti Memet.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Preman Pensiun Deui
programme.desc: Pensiunnya Bahar (pemimpin preman) dan kekacauan yang terjadi di wilayah kekuasaannya setelah ia menyerahkan urusan pada tangan kanannya, Muslihat, yang kemudian mencoba mengambil alih, memicu konflik dengan anak buah seperti Jamal dan Komar, memaksa Bahar turun tangan lagi untuk menyelesaikan masalah dan mengembalikan ketertiban, seperti kasus tanah di kampung dan penahanan Jamal.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Mencintaimu Sekali Lagi Arini (Rr)
programme.desc: Arini, seorang penata rias sukses yang digemari para selebritas papan atas, mengalami patah hati saat memergoki kekasihnya berselingkuh dengan sahabatnya sendiri. Sempat kehilangan kepercayaan pada cinta, ia bertemu dengan Lingga yang perlahan memikat hatinya. Namun, masalah muncul ketika Emil, saudara laki-laki Lingga, juga jatuh hati padanya.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Microdrama + : Ceo Who Killed My Father
programme.desc: Mara, seorang jurnalis yang mencurigai Adrian, pengusaha kejam dan untouchable, diduga terlibat dalam kasus pembunuhan ayahnya, Tony, serta berbagai kasus akuisisi paksa dan pembunuhan pengusaha lainnya. Dibantu oleh sahabatnya, Edgar, dan bosnya, Rino, Mara mengumpulkan bukti sambil berpura - pura dekat dengan Adrian, menghadapi ancaman dari Selena dan Noah, hingga klimaks pesta dimana kejahatan Adrian terbongkar meski dengan pengorbanan besar.

programme.title: Law Or Justice

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion

programme.title: Loving You

programme.title: Royal Tramp II

programme.title: The Comeback

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby

programme.title: Faithfully Yours

programme.desc: Lydia dan Rudy telah pun berkahwin. Lydia nak anak walaupun Rudy belum bersedia lagi. Perangai Lydia makin menjadi- jadi apabila mengikut hukum hakam dari kakiberamal.com.

programme.title: Tebus
programme.desc: Anak perempuan Mikail telah di culik dan untuk menyelamatkan anaknya dia cuba mengimbau kembali sejarah lampau dirinya ketika menyertai kumpulan gangster.

programme.title: Survival 486
programme.desc: Syuhada going hiking to Gunung Tahan with her friends. Unfortunately, she got lost and fell into a deep hole and trapped there for 19 days.

programme.title: Cik Paris Diva Kampung
programme.desc: Zulaikha merupakan seroang gadis bandar yang mencabar diri untuk hidup di kampung lalu terpikat dengan jejaka kampung yang berjaya menawan hatinya.

programme.title: Budak Dari Tak Bai
programme.desc: Melalui kehidupan yang getir, Johari meninggalkan Tak Bai pada zaman kanak-kanak ke Kota Bharu. Peristiwa hitam membuatkannya hanyut dalam dunia gelap. Dilakonkan oleh Kamal Adli dan Nabila Huda.

programme.title: Delen
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Delen yang mula rasa terancam apabila Emily mula menyukai pelajar baru bernama Robert. Sejak itu, bermulalah persaingan antara Delen dan Robert demi merebut cinta Emily.

programme.title: Bro Jenin
programme.desc: Kisah Jenin yang telah masuk ke zaman kini. Dia berjumpa dengan seorang animator, Emily. Wujud perbezaan pendapat maka terjadi lah kisah2 lucu dan akhirnya Jenin terpaksa pulang ke tempat asalnya.
